title: PARIS jump-model regimes vs the frozen rtl-screener two-term rule; LLT features as jump-model inputs
authority: User decision 2026-09-03; constitutional amendment recorded in rtl-screener/research/llt_bakeoff/reports/llt_hysteresis_deadband.md (AMENDMENT 2026-09-03)
data: FMP dividend-adjusted daily OHLC (stable/historical-price-eod/dividend-adjusted); cash = Fama-French daily RF through 2026-06-30 then FMP 3M CMT/252 lagged one day

execution.convention: exposure for day T fixed from information <= close T-1 (PARIS lag=1; screener features computed at close T-1)

market_proxy: SPY (S1 rule computed on SPY; aligned to each ticker's calendar by causal forward-fill)

frozen_incumbent.S1: risk_off = trend_strength < 0 OR PR63(fit_quality) > 0.85 on SPY (rtl_snapshot.market_risk_off / regime_study._risk_off)
frozen_incumbent.engine: RTL-Kalman RTLEKOscillators with rtl_snapshot.DEFAULT_RTL_CONFIG; PR63 via rtl_snapshot._rolling_pr; cross-checked against build_rtl_snapshot on SPY

challengers_stage1: PARIS risk λ=50 (own log EWMA vol)
exploratory_stage1: PARIS trend λ=5 x frozen S1 (not a promotion candidate; attribution only)
stage2_rule: one feature per test, beside the level feature, equal standardised weights inside each rolling window; each test is judged against BOTH the frozen stack and the untouched PARIS model of the same side (risk λ=50 / trend λ=5) on the same metrics; default RETIRE

folds.full_oos: from the first date on which every arm is valid for that ticker (PARIS warm-up 1,260 days + 60) to the last available bar

metrics: flips per year (count of exposure changes)

false_bear_ceiling.definition: in each bull fold, the challenger's cross-ticker median off-fraction must be <= the frozen stack's median off-fraction + 0.10 AND <= 0.35
false_bear_ceiling.why: D1b-X labelled 39-44% of calm periods bear; nothing in the program froze a numeric ceiling before this spec

decision_rule.comparator: frozen S1 x S2 x S3 stack (primary); S2 alone (secondary, like-for-like own-trend rule)
decision_rule.MATCHES: median full-OOS ΔSharpe >= -0.05 AND in every mandatory bear fold median MaxDD >= stack MaxDD - 0.01 AND false-bear ceiling passes in every bull fold
decision_rule.BEATS: MATCHES AND median full-OOS ΔSharpe >= +0.10 AND median ΔMartin > 0
decision_rule.attribution_if_loses: if the deficit is concentrated in the mandatory bear folds (stack exits earlier) -> stress detection (fit quality, F1) is the first addition; if concentrated in the ex-US names (EFA, EEM, TLT, GLD) -> volatility measurement (range-based vol, B1) is; both -> F1 first per the amendment order
decision_rule.uncertainty: paired ticker bootstrap (1,000 draws) 95% CI of the median ΔSharpe; reported, not a gate (n = 8 tickers)

not_tested_here: rank-encoded LLT features as sole inputs (D1b-X binding)
new threshold/hysteresis rules on LLT signals (stopping rule stands)
